messages.author: Siti Rahman
messages.text: Reminder: sponsor review on Friday still has SG go-live as 28 Aug. Please flag blockers before Thursday EOD. MY stays gated on SG — Farah you are fine to keep MY as on track if you have no local issues.

messages.author: Marcus Lim
messages.text: Merchant App consumer is wired in staging. Happy path looks good. I still need Priya's lag numbers before I call this production-ready. MENU-201 on track for 21 Aug if lag work lands.

messages.author: Wei Ming Tan
messages.text: Closed MENU-241. DAG is live. Backfill is in progress in prod so I'm not leaving an open ticket for a running job.

messages.author: Arjun Patel
messages.text: Wei — please don't treat MENU-241 as done. I checked the DAG this afternoon: 62% of SG merchants backfilled. At current throughput we finish Saturday 16 Aug, maybe Sunday if dinner peak throttles us. That is a ~2 day slip vs the 11 Aug due date, and the job is still running. Ticket should be In Progress, not Done.

messages.author: Jin Park
messages.text: Playbook draft is in the doc. Rollback steps still need Daniel's sign-off. Side note: last week's stale-menu incident in SG was painful for ops. I don't see a Harbor ticket for the follow-up. Did we ever file one?

messages.author: Marcus Lim
messages.text: Priya is OOO from yesterday through 20 Aug (leave). MENU-255 is still assigned to her and nothing has moved since Mon. Dinner-peak lag is the cutover gate — we do not have a backup owner. Can someone pick this up or we are stuck.

messages.author: Daniel Koh
messages.text: Thanks Marcus. I cannot cover 255 myself this week. Asking Elena Goh (Director of Engineering) for a loaned engineer. Until lag is actually fixed I will not sign 28 Aug.

messages.author: Farah Hassan
messages.text: MY weekly: we are green. No MY blockers. Dual-run prep can start whenever SG producer is declared live. Keeping MENU-305 On Track for 18 Sep.

messages.author: Arjun Patel
messages.text: Standup update: backfill 71% as of 3pm. Still running. ETA Saturday 16 Aug. If we cut over on 28 Aug with an incomplete backfill, SG merchants not yet migrated will show stale menus — same failure mode as last week.

messages.author: Siti Rahman
messages.text: Morning. I need a single status for the 4pm sponsor review. Jira looks mostly healthy (241 done, 305 on track, 280 still 28 Aug). If engineering wants a different date I need it in writing today, not in a sidebar.

messages.author: Jin Park
messages.text: Confirming for anyone writing status: INC-18472 (P2 stale menus, 6 Aug) is resolved as an incident but the follow-up work is not in Jira. Batch pipeline still serving SG. If Harbor status says 'no open incidents' that is technically true and also not the full story.
